dct_description_sm: Data is structured into eight geographic regions: Africa, Antarctica, Australia-Oceania, Asia, Central America, Europe, North America, and South America.

Data is structured into eight geographic regions: Africa, Antarctica, Australia-Oceania, Asia, Central America, Europe, North America, and South America. Global data for 2018 is available in shapefile format, structured by geographic region and by theme. Due to the 2 GB file size restriction on shapefiles, some thematic data compressed files will contain multiple shapefiles. Geospatial vector data layers exported from OpenStreetMap on 01/01/2018, processed by Geofabrik into shapefile formats. "© OpenStreetMap contributors."
